fields.name: fixAddDamage
fields.when: Lv eq 0 OR 1 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0 OR 1 lo Lv AND 2 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0

fields.name: bonusSkillRate
fields.when: Lv eq 0 OR 1 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0 OR 1 lo Lv AND 2 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0

fields.name: bonusFixAddDamage
fields.when: Lv eq 0 OR 1 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0 OR 1 lo Lv AND 2 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0

fields.name: slowPercent
fields.when: Lv eq 0 OR 1 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0 OR 1 lo Lv AND 2 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0

fields.name: skillRate
fields.when: 1 lo Lv AND 2 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0

fields.name: damageCount
fields.when: 1 lo Lv AND 2 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0 OR 1 lo Lv AND 2 lo Lv AND 3 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0 OR 1 lo Lv AND 2 lo Lv AND 3 lo Lv AND Lv ne 0

fields.name: skillRate
fields.when: 1 lo Lv AND 2 lo Lv AND 3 hs Lv AND Lv ne 0

fields.name: skillRate
fields.when: 1 lo Lv AND 2 lo Lv AND 3 lo Lv AND Lv ne 0

fields.name: addExcetraDamage
fields.when: MobaMode ne 0 AND damageCount lt 1 OR 1 ge damageCount AND MobaMode ne 0 AND damageCount ge 1 OR MobaMode ne 0 AND PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Slow, slowPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount lt 1

fields.name: SkillParam
fields.when: (SkillParam & 32) ne 0 AND MobaMode eq 0 AND SkillActionBase.checkPercent(this, 100, SkillMasteryBase.GetMasteryParam(MasteryId.Trigger)) AND damageCount lt 1 OR (SkillParam & 32) eq 0 AND MobaMode eq 0 AND SkillActionBase.checkPercent(this, 100, SkillMasteryBase.GetMasteryParam(MasteryId.Trigger)) AND damageCount lt 1 OR (SkillParam & 32) ne 0 AND 1 ge damageCount AND MobaMode eq 0 AND SkillActionBase.checkPercent(this, 100, SkillMasteryBase.GetMasteryParam(MasteryId.Trigger)) AND damageCount ge 1

terms.name: SetRate[LastDamageRate]
terms.when: (SkillParam & 32) ne 0 AND MobaMode eq 0 AND SkillActionBase.checkPercent(this, 100, SkillMasteryBase.GetMasteryParam(MasteryId.Trigger)) AND damageCount lt 1 OR (SkillParam & 32) ne 0 AND 1 ge damageCount AND MobaMode eq 0 AND SkillActionBase.checkPercent(this, 100, SkillMasteryBase.GetMasteryParam(MasteryId.Trigger)) AND damageCount ge 1 OR (SkillParam & 32) ne 0 AND MobaMode eq 0 AND SkillActionBase.checkPercent(this, 100, SkillMasteryBase.GetMasteryParam(MasteryId.Trigger)) AND TryGetProperties<object>.out2(mobAction, 90) ne 0 AND damageCount lt 1

terms.name: AddRate[LastDamageRate]
terms.when: (SkillParam & 32) ne 0 AND MobaMode eq 0 AND SkillActionBase.checkPercent(this, 100, SkillMasteryBase.GetMasteryParam(MasteryId.Trigger)) AND TryGetProperties<object>.out2(mobAction, 90) ne 0 AND damageCount lt 1 OR (SkillParam & 32) ne 0 AND 1 ge damageCount AND MobaMode eq 0 AND SkillActionBase.checkPercent(this, 100, SkillMasteryBase.GetMasteryParam(MasteryId.Trigger)) AND TryGetProperties<object>.out2(mobAction, 90) ne 0 AND damageCount ge 1 OR (SkillParam & 32) ne 0 AND MobaMode eq 0 AND PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Slow, slowPercent, playerAction) AND SkillActionBase.checkPercent(this, 100, SkillMasteryBase.GetMasteryParam(MasteryId.Trigger)) AND TryGetProperties<object>.out2(mobAction, 90) ne 0 AND damageCount lt 1

effects.name: PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent
effects.when: PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Slow, slowPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount lt 1 OR !PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Slow, slowPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount lt 1 OR 1 ge damageCount AND PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Slow, slowPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount ge 1

effects.name: SkillDamageData.SetAbnormalType
effects.when: PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Slow, slowPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount lt 1 OR 1 ge damageCount AND PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Slow, slowPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount ge 1 OR MobaMode ne 0 AND PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Slow, slowPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount lt 1
